exact_statement: For any actual uniform Boolean controller-only stopping tree whose Fourier-square laws at every node factor as p_v(c,u,z)=pbar_v(c,u)k(z|u) with one fixed normalized conditional kernel k, and whose complete references use that same k, every actual controller entropy decrement, physical queried influence, conditional-erasure KL, branch-outcome KL and signed Bayes-to-chosen-child reset equals its quotient counterpart. Full cross-entropy is quotient cross-entropy plus L_v=E H(k(.|U)); L_root=E L_leaf, so all terminal spectator entropy is retained once. A previously certified quotient controller price transfers unchanged, without asserting the quotient spectra are Boolean. Matching source/reference conditionals is necessary and sufficient for zero omitted conditional KL. Common independent Boolean factors in every core including fallback satisfy the hypothesis; a certified factor entropy/influence bill is charged once. At any fresh uniform query outside spectator block Z, DeltaL=I(branch;S_Z|T)-I(S_i;S_Z|T), hence [DeltaL]_+<=2 Inf_i(f)/ln(2). If source/reference likelihood p/q is a positive function of retained quotient frequency T on their whole support, actual coherent transport produces Bayes children with matching conditional spectator laws and no extra conditional KL reset; the quotient reset and terminal debts remain. The actual first-data-query h3 example has correction 1-(3/8)log2(3)>0, so unchanged controller cancellation does not extend to arbitrary data queries. Full FEI and arbitrary nonmatching conditional-reference payment remain open.

exact_statement: For nonconstant Boolean indicator A(C) on disjoint controls and Boolean g(U,Z), a controller prefix resolving F=1+A(g-1) to active g and inactive +1 has a hereditary conditional spectral kernel k(s_Z|s_U) if and only if E_U g is physically constant in Z (all pure-Z nonempty coefficients vanish). With mu=E g and beta=Var_Z(E_U g), disjoint T-fold copied partitions have beta_T=(mu^2+beta)^T-mu^(2T). For arbitrary Boolean seed g, fresh retained sign x, m,T>=1 and t=2^-m, the actual guarded activation F=1+AND_m(C)(x*g_tensor_T(Z)-1) has Boolean quotient F0=1+AND_m(C)(x-1), kernel k(.|empty_x)=empty point mass and k(.|{x})=P_g_tensor_T, H(F)=H(F0)+tT H(g), I(F)=t(m+1+T I(g)), removed controller influence mt and retained terminal entropy tT H(g), terminal influence t(1+T I(g)). Its complete controller entropy price satisfies H(F0)<7mt. For any normalized dominating seed reference Q_g, the single reference obtained by lifting P_F0 with Q_g_tensor_T on the guard-frequency row has CE=H(F0)+tT CE(P_g,Q_g), KL=tT KL(P_g,Q_g); its actual controller Bayes transport retains all this seed KL at terminals with zero erasure/outcome KL and no reset. This common-k admitted class and its rare/weak-influence subsequence have exactly the full FEI optimal constant, by fixed-m tensor limits or m(T)=ceil(2log2(T+1)). A seed spectator query reinstates t times the full seed entropy decrement and t times its queried influence. The four-variable guarded AND2 fixture has drift1, quotient drift0 and influence1/4, exceeding 2Inf/ln2; it refutes only the exploratory extension of A050 outside-Z drift payment to spectator queries. No FEI result follows without full terminal/seed payment.
